name: IPSEA — SEND law information and advice
description: Independent Provider of Special Education Advice (IPSEA), an England charity providing free SEND-law guides, template letters, helplines and casework support.
intended_use: Understand and navigate legal routes in England's special educational needs and disability education system.
audience_or_context: Parents, carers, children and young people dealing with SEND education issues in England.
limitations: IPSEA's SEND-law remit is England; Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland have different legal systems and routes.
General web information cannot determine the facts or outcome of an individual legal dispute.
cost_or_access_notes: IPSEA provides free public legal information and free helpline/casework services subject to availability; training can have separate charges.
conflicts_of_interest: IPSEA is a specialist SEND-law charity and advocacy organisation; ND Oracle links to its current legal-information route without making a legal determination.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
